body:
Kanban PARENA-0001 resolved: built a real no-root musl toolchain, confirmed parena-c compiles clean static under musl, found and fixed the real blocker (parena_runtime.h's unconditional SDL2 include), proved a real headless stdlib program (sip/message.prn) builds+runs as a fully static musl binary with zero shared-library deps -- the real Alpine-portable shape. New docs/OS_PORTABILITY_NORTHSTAR.md, golden doc PARENA-OS-PORTABILITY-NORTH. Commit 050d145.

⚓ ☃
title: PARENA OS portability: real musl/Alpine vertical slice + PARENA_NO_GRAPHICS fix
